dict.string: NanoNexus reads files on your Desktop only when you ask an assistant to analyze them.
NanoNexus reads files in Documents only when you ask an assistant to analyze them.
NanoNexus scans Downloads only when you ask it to (for example, a Folder Scout report).
NanoNexus can analyze folders and import model packs from external drives you select.
NanoNexus can analyze folders on network drives you select.
NanoNexus uses your local network only when you turn on LAN Share, so your phone can reach your assistants.
